evidence.name: Screen field: Where the error text sits
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Where the error text sits" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Where the error text sits
sections.description: Aligns the validation error message to the left, center, or right. Match it to the field's own text alignment (left is typical) so the message sits naturally under the input. Keeping them aligned makes it obvious which field was rejected, so users fix it quickly and don't stall.
